authority: Agent-authored under CLAUDE.md, recording deviations from R1's criteria that the operator approved in session on 2026-10-21. Execution aid (CLAUDE.md §10.2). Closes no gate and amends no constitutional rule.
decision: R1 is verified against its criteria as adapted to the 'Sign up for AWS (new)' Free plan account: the console default Region item is N/A, and the budget alert is evidenced by its ALARM state rather than a delivered e-mail, with a CLI check of credits and alert states at the start of every working session and weekly in R14.
why: Two R1 items cannot be done in this account on the Free plan: Unified Settings needs the paid plan, and notification-contact verification is denied by the project SCP DenyNotificationContactsOperations, so budget e-mail recipients stay Inactive.

decisions.question: Console home Region set to the OD1 Region
decisions.reason: Unified Settings is refused on the Free plan (docs/infrastructure_security/evidence_v2/R1/R1_11_unified-settings-unavailable.png). The project's Region is eu-north-1 (docs/infrastructure_security/evidence_v2/R1/R1_11_default-region.png, R1_32_aws-settings-projects.png).
decisions.consequence: Every step sheet names --region eu-north-1 explicitly; the operator uses the console Region selector. Revisit at the OD10 upgrade.

decisions.question: Budget recipient verified and a test alert received
decisions.answer: Replaced by: the test budget's notification reached ALARM (docs/infrastructure_security/evidence_v2/R1/R1_20_test-alert-state.json), plus a CLI check of remaining credits (freetier get-account-plan-state) and budget notification states at the start of every working session and weekly in R14.
decisions.reason: Verification e-mails cannot be sent (docs/infrastructure_security/evidence_v2/R1/R1_18_recipient-inactive-verification-denied.png); AWS Settings offers no other notification channel, and the CLI has no Free Tier alert-preference command. On the Free plan no charge accrues; the risk is credit exhaustion closing the account.
decisions.consequence: OD13's 10 USD budget stays as an evaluated guard whose state is read by CLI, not as an e-mail alarm. R14 must script the check; every later step sheet that creates billable resources starts with it. Revisit at the OD10 upgrade.

decisions.question: Account-level EBS encryption and IMDSv2 defaults
decisions.answer: Set and evidenced in eu-north-1 (docs/infrastructure_security/evidence_v2/R1/R1_12_ebs-default-encryption-eu-north-1.json, R1_14_imds-defaults-eu-north-1.json). The us-east-1 refusals are kept as history; STEPS_fix2's N/A is not needed.
decisions.reason: OD1 moved to eu-north-1, where the SCPs allow these settings.
decisions.consequence: R11 still sets both on the host itself.

privacy.claim: No secret value, credential, prompt text or proposal content.
